svg.title: UML class box for Robot
svg.desc: A UML class box with three compartments. Tag 1, the top: the class name Robot. Tag 2, the middle: the attributes, one per line: plus name: str, marked readOnly in braces; plus battery: int; plus slash status: str; plus total_robots: int, underlined. Tag 3, the bottom: the operations: plus perform_task(task: str, minutes: int): bool; plus recharge().
